abrigo_refugio.title: Emergency debris shelter
abrigo_refugio.context: same adult survivor in an olive jacket, gray backpack, dry pine forest clearing at late afternoon
panels: Select dry wind-protected ground with no dead branches overhead; lay a 20–30 cm thick bed of dry pine boughs
Build a stable compact lean-to frame with a low ridgepole and sturdy angled branches
Cover the frame with dense overlapping leaves and boughs; show the dry insulated bed and entrance facing away from wind
es: Elige terreno seco y aísla el suelo
Construye un armazón bajo y estable
Cubre bien y orienta la entrada contra el viento
en: Choose dry ground and insulate it
Build a low, stable frame
Cover it densely and face the entrance away from wind
abrigo_refugio.avoid: fire inside the shelter, unstable branches, dead branch overhead, impossible knots

agua_survival.title: Emergency water purification
agua_survival.context: same adult in blue on one dry stream bank, same clean bottle, folded cloth, stainless pot, lid and stable outdoor stove
panels: hold clean bottle above gravel and collect from a clear flowing section upstream without any clean item touching mud or streambed
on dry bank stretch clean folded cloth securely over pot and pour slowly; pot rim and clean side stay off ground
show pot at vigorous rolling boil with large bubbles and steam on stable outdoor stove, clean lid beside it
es: Recolecta de agua corriente sin contaminarla
Prefiltra el sedimento con tela limpia
Hierve vigorosamente y deja enfriar tapada
en: Collect from flowing water without contaminating it
Prefilter sediment through clean cloth
Bring to a rolling boil and cool covered
agua_survival.avoid: cloth or clean container on dirt, stagnant pool, drinking untreated water, dirty hands in water, indoor stove

alimentacion_supervivencia.title: Safe emergency fish preparation
alimentacion_supervivencia.context: same adult in olive shirt, same whole fish, clean board, knife, waste bag and small camp stove on one dry riverside work surface
panels: on stable board hold fish with non-cutting hand far behind blade and cut away from fingers and body
remove entrails into separate open waste bag far from edible flesh and water source; clean fillets stay on board
cook same fish pieces in covered metal pan on stable stove until opaque, flaky and visibly steaming
es: Limpia el pescado lejos del agua potable
Retira vísceras y separa los desechos
Cocina completamente antes de comer
en: Clean the fish away from drinking water
Remove entrails and isolate waste
Cook thoroughly before eating
alimentacion_supervivencia.avoid: knife toward fingers, raw fish consumption, guts mixed with fillets, waste near water, contaminated board

atragantamiento.title: Adult choking response training
atragantamiento.context: same life-size adult first-aid training manikin dressed blue and same female instructor in gray, empty training room, fixed side camera, freeze-action
panels: instructor supports manikin chest with one forearm, leans it clearly forward and places open heel of other hand between shoulder blades for one back blow
upright same manikin; instructor behind forms one visible fist just above navel and below breastbone, other hand grasps fist for inward-upward thrust
same single manikin lies once on firm floor; instructor kneels at side with exactly two stacked hands centered on chest to begin CPR
es: Inclina hacia delante y da 5 golpes interescapulares
Alterna con 5 compresiones abdominales
Si pierde respuesta, llama e inicia RCP
en: Lean forward and give 5 back blows
Alternate with 5 abdominal thrusts
If unresponsive, call and start CPR
atragantamiento.avoid: real choking patient, duplicate manikin or instructor, ghosting, motion blur, fist on ribs or sternum, slap on neck, two bodies on floor

balsa_improvisada.title: Improvised raft construction for calm water
balsa_improvisada.context: same two adults both wearing visible red PFDs in all panels, same dry logs, sealed jugs, rope and calm shallow shore
panels: at shore one adult submerges one sealed jug to confirm watertight while other tests one dry log; no raft yet
on dry shore both build one rigid rectangular log frame and lash even row of sealed jugs underneath
tether completed empty raft and test in knee-deep still water; then one PFD-wearing adult kneels centered while second PFD-wearing adult holds safety line ashore
es: Úsala solo en agua calma y prueba los flotadores
Arma un marco rígido y distribuye la flotación
Prueba vacía, con cuerda y chaleco salvavidas
en: Use only on calm water and test every float
Build a rigid frame and distribute buoyancy
Test it empty, tethered and with a life jacket
balsa_improvisada.avoid: rapids, deep-water first test, missing PFD, extra people, standing passenger, loose open containers, impossible lashings

bosque_agua.title: Finding and making forest water safe
bosque_agua.context: same adult hiker with map, bottle, cloth and metal pot in one temperate forest valley
panels: Stop and listen, then follow a shaded gully downhill toward denser green vegetation and audible flowing water
Collect from a moving upstream section using a clean bottle without disturbing muddy sediment
Prefilter through clean cloth and boil in a metal pot on a stable outdoor stove
es: Busca agua siguiendo cauces y vegetación cuesta abajo
Recolecta de una corriente clara sin remover lodo
Prefiltra y hierve antes de beber
en: Follow gullies and greener vegetation downhill
Collect from clear moving water without stirring mud
Prefilter and boil before drinking
bosque_agua.avoid: drinking directly, stagnant green water, collecting downstream of contamination, improvised poisonous plants

bosque_orientacion.title: STOP protocol when lost in a forest
bosque_orientacion.context: same adult hiker in orange shell with same backpack at one forest trail junction near sunset
panels: hiker immediately stops, sits on dry rock beside exact junction and calms down instead of continuing
at same rock hiker studies one map beside real compass and checks water, headlamp and phone
hiker stays beside junction, ties one large bright orange signal cloth at eye level and finishes one compact low emergency tarp shelter before dark
es: Detente y evita caminar por pánico
Ubica el último punto seguro y revisa recursos
Señaliza y prepara refugio antes de oscurecer
en: Stop and do not panic-walk
Identify the last certain point and check resources
Signal and prepare shelter before dark
bosque_orientacion.avoid: random wandering, absent signal, no shelter, night travel, changed location, illegible compass

bosque_peligros.title: Preventing common forest injuries
bosque_peligros.context: same adult hiker wearing boots, gloves and long trousers at one forest campsite
panels: Step onto a fallen log and look beyond it before stepping down; use a hiking pole to inspect leaf litter
Shake boots and clothing upside down before putting them on, revealing a small insect falling away
Use fine tweezers to grasp a tick close to skin and pull straight upward without twisting
es: Mira antes de pisar o meter las manos
Sacude botas y ropa antes de usarlas
Retira garrapatas recto desde la base
en: Look before stepping or reaching
Shake boots and clothing before use
Pull ticks straight up from the base
bosque_peligros.avoid: bare hands in holes, stepping blindly over logs, burning or twisting tick, dangerous animal attack

botiquin.title: Build and maintain an emergency first-aid kit
botiquin.context: same red first-aid pouch and realistic supplies on one clean olive table, fixed overhead camera, only one pair of adult hands
panels: lay out gloves, gauze, pressure bandage, tape, shears, triangular bandage, splint and blanket in separated groups
compare one intact sealed gauze packet with one visibly torn stained packet and set damaged packet aside beside empty blister
pack intact supplies into separate transparent waterproof pouches by category, with gloves and gauze accessible on top
es: Reúne material esencial por función
Revisa sellos, cantidades y vencimientos
Empaca por categorías y protege del agua
en: Gather essential supplies by function
Check seals, quantities and expiry dates
Pack by category and protect from water
botiquin.avoid: more than two hands, loose pills, readable labels, open sterile supplies kept, duplicate impossible tools

convulsiones.title: Safe seizure first aid
convulsiones.context: same adult role-playing a seizure and same trained rescuer in uncluttered living room, same clothes, one phone timer and folded sweater
panels: casualty lies once; rescuer starts visible phone timer on floor, moves chair away and slides folded sweater under head without touching arms or legs
during simulated convulsions rescuer stays an arm length away with open empty hands, area clear, nothing in mouth and no restraint
after movement stops rescuer uses shoulder and hip to roll same casualty into stable recovery position with mouth downward and watches breathing
es: Mide el tiempo, despeja el área y protege la cabeza
No sujetes ni pongas nada en la boca
Al terminar, posición lateral y vigila respiración
en: Time it, clear the area and protect the head
Do not restrain or place anything in the mouth
When it stops, recovery position and monitor breathing
convulsiones.avoid: restraint, hand on chest or limbs during convulsions, object in mouth, water, recovery position during active convulsions, duplicate body

cruce_rios.title: Safe river crossing decision and technique
cruce_rios.context: same adult hiker with backpack, chest-high pole and PFD at one shallow wide river in daylight
panels: Walk the bank and choose the widest shallow straight section, rejecting a nearby foamy fast channel
Unclip backpack hip and chest straps and plant a strong pole upstream before entering
Cross diagonally facing upstream with two feet and the pole forming three points of contact, water below the knees
es: Busca la zona más ancha, baja y lenta
Suelta las correas y usa un bastón fuerte
Cruza de lado con tres apoyos
en: Choose the widest, shallowest, slowest section
Release pack straps and use a strong pole
Cross sideways with three points of contact
cruce_rios.avoid: waist-deep current, linked group chain, clipped hip belt, pole downstream, rapids

fracturas_inmovilizacion.title: Improvised splinting training
fracturas_inmovilizacion.context: same adult casualty and rescuer using realistic forearm simulator, same two padded rigid boards, broad ties and triangular sling
panels: check finger warmth, color, sensation and movement beyond simulated forearm injury
without straightening place one padded rigid board on each side spanning beyond wrist and elbow, both boards fully visible
fasten broad ties above and below injury without knots over it, recheck fingers, support fully splinted arm in sling
es: Revisa circulación y sensibilidad distal
Acolcha e inmoviliza como está
Sujeta arriba y abajo; vuelve a revisar
en: Check distal circulation and sensation
Pad and splint in the position found
Tie above and below, then recheck
fracturas_inmovilizacion.avoid: single missing splint, straightening deformity, knot over injury, splint only as bandage, impossible arm

fuego_supervivencia.title: Starting a survival fire with a ferro rod
fuego_supervivencia.context: same adult survivor with tan gloves, ferro rod, fixed-blade knife and sheltered bare-soil fire site in daylight
panels: Prepare separate piles of fluffy dry tinder, pencil-thin kindling, finger-thick sticks and larger dry wood before making a spark
Scrape the ferro rod with the back spine of the knife, directing sparks into the tinder bundle with stable safe hand positions
Feed a contained small flame gradually with thin kindling while larger wood waits nearby and water is ready
es: Prepara yesca y leña por tamaños
Dirige chispas a la yesca con postura segura
Alimenta la llama de menor a mayor
en: Prepare tinder and wood by size
Direct sparks safely into the tinder
Feed the flame from small to larger fuel
fuego_supervivencia.avoid: gasoline, indoor fire, wet wood, scraping with sharp blade edge, forest fire, malformed hands

hemorragia_severa.title: Severe bleeding control training
hemorragia_severa.context: same full-length realistic bleeding-control leg simulator oriented with hip at left and foot at right, same trained rescuer wearing blue nitrile gloves, white gauze and one black commercial windlass tourniquet in a bright training room
panels: expose one simulated bleeding wound on middle of thigh and apply firm direct pressure with thick folded gauze using both stacked gloved hands
pack one continuous strip of gauze tightly into same wound cavity and keep one gloved hand pressing over packed gauze
place commercial windlass tourniquet on bare thigh 5–7 cm toward hip from wound, never over wound or joint; pull strap tight and twist clearly visible rigid windlass rod
es: Expón la herida y presiona con fuerza
Rellena con gasa y mantén presión
Si no cede en una extremidad, coloca torniquete sobre la herida
en: Expose the wound and press hard
Pack with gauze and maintain pressure
If limb bleeding persists, place a tourniquet above it
hemorragia_severa.avoid: tourniquet distal to wound, over wound or joint, missing windlass rod, loose cord, cotton balls, bare hands, real gore, malformed limb

hipotermia_golpe_calor.title: Temperature emergency first aid
hipotermia_golpe_calor.context: two clearly separate scenarios: panels 1 and 2 same hypothermia casualty inside cold shelter; panel 3 different heat-stroke casualty under shade in hot daylight
panels: inside shelter remove same casualty wet outer jacket while immediately covering body with dry blankets
same casualty dry and fully wrapped above and below; cloth-wrapped warm bottles only at chest armpits and groin
separate hot-weather casualty lies confused under shade while rescuer removes outer clothing, soaks skin, fans and applies wrapped cold packs at neck armpits and groin while phone calls
es: Hipotermia: refugia, seca y quita ropa mojada
Recalienta gradualmente el centro del cuerpo
Golpe de calor: enfría rápido y busca ayuda
en: Hypothermia: shelter, dry and remove wet clothing
Rewarm the body core gradually
Heat stroke: cool rapidly and get help
hipotermia_golpe_calor.avoid: hot bath, rubbing cold limbs, naked casualty, direct heat or ice on skin, confused heat casualty drinking

huracan.title: Hurricane preparation and shelter
huracan.context: same family and home across hurricane timeline: calm daylight, darkening sky before winds, storm outside while all indoors
panels: well before storm in calm weather adults bring furniture inside and fasten proper shutters; no wind or rain
before wind family carries water, first-aid kit, flashlight, radio and document pouch into interior windowless room
during strongest winds every family member shelters low inside that room away from windows using battery lights and radio
es: Asegura el exterior y protege ventanas
Lleva suministros al cuarto interior
Refúgiate lejos de ventanas y monitorea alertas
en: Secure outdoors and protect windows
Move supplies to an interior room
Shelter away from windows and monitor alerts
huracan.avoid: working outdoors in wind or rain, taping windows, candles, standing at windows, generator indoors

infarto_acv.title: Recognize heart attack and stroke and act
infarto_acv.context: same older man in blue seated in one living room and same female rescuer in green, same phone, clock and closed AED case
panels: seated man has asymmetric facial droop, cannot keep one arm raised and presses center of chest; rescuer observes without medicine or drink
rescuer stops activity, supports him semi-reclined, points to wall clock for symptom start time and calls on speaker
same man calm and still; rescuer loosens collar, watches breathing and places closed AED nearby without attaching it while conscious
es: Reconoce dolor de pecho o signos FAST
Detén actividad, anota la hora y llama
Mantén reposo y vigila respiración
en: Recognize chest pain or FAST signs
Stop activity, note the time and call
Keep at rest and monitor breathing
infarto_acv.avoid: extra people, both arms weak, walking patient, food, drink, pills, AED pads on conscious patient, delayed call

intoxicaciones.title: Suspected poisoning response
intoxicaciones.context: same drowsy but breathing adult and same gloved rescuer in kitchen with one tipped cleaner bottle, open exterior door and speakerphone
panels: without entering visible fumes or touching spill rescuer opens route and guides walking casualty into clean outdoor air
in fresh air rescuer leaves original container upright at safe distance and calls poison control or emergency services on speaker
when same casualty becomes drowsy but still breathing rescuer places them once on side in stable recovery position and monitors breathing
es: Aléjate de la fuente sin exponerte
Identifica el producto y llama con el envase a mano
Vigila respiración; no induzcas vómito
en: Move away from the source without exposure
Identify the product and call with the container
Monitor breathing; do not induce vomiting
intoxicaciones.avoid: rescuer in fumes, carrying duplicate casualty, spraying or mixing chemicals, milk, water, vomiting, bare-hand contact

inundacion.title: Flood evacuation safety
inundacion.context: same family, same two-story home and neighborhood during a rising-flood timeline; panel 1 completely dry interior, panel 2 completely dry elevated evacuation route with floodwater only far in background, panel 3 trapped home
panels: before water arrives while floor and electrical panel are completely dry, one adult switches off main breaker as family moves documents, medicines and emergency kit upstairs
family evacuates early on a clearly elevated dry sidewalk with dry shoes and small go-bags; moving floodwater is visible only in a distant lower street and nobody steps into it
if trapped later, family moves to highest safe upper-level balcony and waves one bright cloth for rescue while far from power lines and floodwater
es: Sube documentos y corta energía solo en seco
Evacúa temprano por una ruta sin agua
Si quedas atrapado, sube y señaliza
en: Elevate documents and shut power only while dry
Evacuate early by a dry route
If trapped, go high and signal
inundacion.avoid: feet in any water during evacuation, walking or driving through floodwater, wet electrical panel, rooftop near power lines, duplicate people

mordeduras_picaduras.title: Snakebite first aid
mordeduras_picaduras.context: same adult hiker with simulated lower-leg snakebite and same two trained rescuers at trailhead, padded splint, rigid litter and phone
panels: seat casualty still while one rescuer removes ankle jewelry and loosens footwear; nobody searches for snake
immobilize bitten leg as found with softly padded splint and loose broad ties, at or slightly below heart level
two rescuers carry casualty level on rigid litter without walking while phone calls for urgent transport
es: Aléjate, mantén calma y quita objetos apretados
Inmoviliza sin apretar ni elevar
No camines: pide traslado urgente
en: Move away, stay calm and remove tight items
Immobilize without tight wrapping or elevation
Do not walk; arrange urgent transport
mordeduras_picaduras.avoid: single-person carry, walking casualty, tourniquet, tight pressure bandage, cutting, suction, ice, catching snake

navegacion.title: Improvised compass with a magnetized needle
navegacion.context: same pair of hands, steel needle, bar magnet, flat cork disk, wide glass bowl of still water and ordinary compass on level outdoor table, fixed overhead camera
panels: stroke one needle end in one direction with same magnet pole while free hand safely holds opposite end
lay magnetized needle horizontal across center of dry flat cork disk with equal overhang and magnet away
float cork and needle at center of perfectly still water with both hands and magnet removed; compare settled axis with nearby ordinary compass needle
es: Imanta la aguja siempre en un sentido
Equilíbrala sobre corcho en agua quieta
Deja que se alinee y confirma con una referencia
en: Magnetize the needle in one direction
Balance it on cork in still water
Let it align and verify with a reference
navegacion.avoid: needle absent or sinking, spinning water, hands touching final bowl, magnet beside bowl, metal container, false labels

nudos_supervivencia.title: Photorealistic bowline knot sequence
nudos_supervivencia.context: same single thick orange rope on matte dark tabletop, fixed directly overhead, same two tan gloved hands, sharp focus
panels: form one small loop in standing part while leaving one large open fixed-loop bight; exactly two rope ends and no knot yet
pass working end up through small loop, around behind standing part and back down through same loop with crossings visible
pull standing part and working end to dress completed bowline: one compact knot, one large fixed loop and long working tail, exactly two rope ends
es: Forma el seno y un bucle pequeño
Pasa el chicote, rodea el firme y regresa
Ordena y aprieta el lazo fijo
en: Form the bight and a small loop
Pass the end through, around and back
Dress and tighten the fixed loop
nudos_supervivencia.avoid: overhand final knot, slip knot, impossible topology, hidden crossing, disconnected rope, more than two ends

parto_emergencia.title: Emergency childbirth simulation training
parto_emergencia.context: same obviously molded plastic obstetric birth simulator and newborn training doll, fixed clinical training table, only one pair of blue-gloved instructor hands, instructor body and face never visible
panels: overhead clean towels, blanket, gloves and phone arranged beside covered obstetric simulator; gloved hands open one clean towel, no birth anatomy visible yet
close side view of synthetic baby-doll head crowning from molded simulator; two open gloved hands only support head without pulling, no blood
same newborn training doll fully delivered, visibly dried and lying on simulator chest skin-to-skin under one dry blanket with face uncovered; only two gloved hands adjust blanket
es: Prepara un área limpia, tibia y con guantes
Sostén suavemente; nunca jales al bebé
Seca, piel con piel, abriga y vigila
en: Prepare a clean warm area and wear gloves
Support gently; never pull the baby
Dry, skin-to-skin, cover and monitor
parto_emergencia.avoid: real person, instructor face or body, blood, gore, extra baby, fused anatomy, smoke, ghosting, motion blur, pulling head, hands covering airway

pesca_trampas_supervivencia.title: Build and use a bottle fish trap
pesca_trampas_supervivencia.context: same clear plastic bottle, utility knife, stable cutting board, cord, bait and shallow slow stream, same adult wearing intact gloves
panels: on stable board cut top third from bottle with blade moving away from bracing hand far behind cutting line
invert cut top as centered funnel, make matched holes and tie parts securely, place bait inside
anchor completed trap underwater beside calm bank with funnel opening downstream and retrieval cord tied to stake above water; hands out of stream
es: Corta la botella con control y lejos de las manos
Invierte la boca, átala y añade carnada
Ancla en agua calma y deja cuerda de recuperación
en: Cut the bottle safely away from hands
Invert and tie the funnel, then add bait
Anchor in calm water with a retrieval line
pesca_trampas_supervivencia.avoid: hand in blade path, rapids, loose sharp plastic, impossible bottle geometry, person holding trap underwater, missing line

primeros_auxilios_extremos.title: MARCH/XABCDE first-look trauma sequence training
primeros_auxilios_extremos.context: same realistic trauma manikin, same trained rescuer in gloves and same safe outdoor training scene
panels: Pause at the edge and check for traffic, fire, wires and other scene hazards before approaching the manikin
Identify simulated massive limb bleeding and apply immediate hard direct pressure with gloved hands and gauze
Open and assess the airway while maintaining head alignment, then look-listen-feel for breathing and expose only what is necessary
es: Primero confirma que la escena sea segura
Controla hemorragia masiva de inmediato
Después revisa vía aérea y respiración
en: First confirm the scene is safe
Control massive bleeding immediately
Then assess airway and breathing
primeros_auxilios_extremos.avoid: real gore, rescuer in traffic, skipping massive bleeding, blind neck hyperextension, invasive airway tool, extra limbs

quemaduras.title: Correct first aid for a thermal burn
quemaduras.context: same adult casualty, same kitchen sink and trained helper, non-graphic simulated forearm burn, same clothing
panels: Stop the heat source and move the forearm safely away; remove a watch and ring before swelling
Cool the simulated burn under gentle clean cool-to-lukewarm running water for 20 minutes, not ice
Cover loosely with clean non-stick dressing or plastic film and keep the casualty warm while seeking help
es: Detén la causa y retira joyas
Enfría con agua corriente durante 20 minutos
Cubre suelto y busca atención
en: Stop the cause and remove jewelry
Cool under running water for 20 minutes
Cover loosely and seek care
quemaduras.avoid: ice, toothpaste, butter, broken blisters, fluffy cotton, tight wrapping, graphic burn, malformed arm

rcp_adulto.title: Adult CPR and AED training sequence
rcp_adulto.context: same clearly plastic adult CPR manikin with bare chest on same firm gray mat, fixed high overhead-oblique camera; only one instructor pair of forearms/hands enters, no instructor face or full body
panels: one hand taps manikin shoulder while black phone on speaker lies visible beside head; second hand is outside frame and chest is unobstructed
exactly two hands stacked at center of lower half sternum, fingers interlocked, both elbows straight and shoulders vertically aligned but instructor face cropped out
no person touches manikin: exactly two adhesive AED pads connected by visible cables to open yellow AED; one pad upper right chest below collarbone and one lower left lateral chest below armpit
es: Comprueba respuesta y respiración; llama
Comprime en el centro con brazos rectos
Coloca el DEA y nadie toca durante el análisis
en: Check response and breathing; call
Compress the center with straight arms
Attach the AED and keep clear during analysis
rcp_adulto.avoid: instructor face or duplicate body, ghosting, motion blur, pad over nipple or abdomen, missing cable, disconnected AED, hands touching during analysis

rcp_nino_bebe.title: Infant CPR training sequence updated for AHA 2025
rcp_nino_bebe.context: same clearly plastic infant CPR manikin in white diaper on same firm gray mat, fixed overhead camera; only one instructor pair of bare forearms and hands enters frame, instructor face and body never visible
panels: tight close-up of the underside of one raised manikin foot: one instructor index finger visibly presses the center of the sole, far from toes; other hand completely outside frame; black speakerphone lies beside mat and head remains neutral

tight overhead-oblique crop from manikin shoulders to upper abdomen, diaper outside frame: ONLY the heel at the base of ONE open adult palm contacts the center of the lower half of the sternum just below nipple line; a clearly visible air gap separates all five naturally arched fingers from the chest; wrist straight, fingers point toward head, other hand and arm completely outside image

tight side-profile close-up: adult mouth is centered over and visibly encloses BOTH the small manikin nose and open mouth inside one continuous lip seal, not nose-only; manikin head neutral to very slightly extended, one adult hand supports forehead, chest only slightly elevated, no other hand near chest or abdomen
es: Comprueba respuesta y deja la cabeza neutral
Comprime con la base de una mano en el esternón
Da ventilación suave: solo debe elevarse el pecho
en: Check response and keep the head neutral
Compress with the heel of one hand on the sternum
Give a gentle breath for slight chest rise
rcp_nino_bebe.avoid: touching toes instead of center sole, two-finger compressions, two hands on chest, whole palm flat on chest, any finger touching chest, fingers or palm on abdomen, contact near diaper, second hand or second arm in compression panel, adult chest contact in response check, neck hyperextension, nose-only breath, mouth-only breath, nose outside rescue-breath seal, pinched nose, aggressive ventilation, real infant, duplicated mannequin, extra hands, ghosting, motion blur, split screen within any panel, illustration, vector art, CGI or 3D render

refugio_naturaleza.title: Wilderness lean-to shelter construction
refugio_naturaleza.context: same adult survivor with tarp-free natural materials in one pine forest, same ridgepole, cord and daylight progression
panels: Before any frame exists, choose flat dry ground protected from wind, visibly look upward to check for dead branches, then build only a thick dry insulated sleeping bed on the ground; absolutely no ridgepole, upright frame or shelter structure yet
Secure a strong ridgepole between stable supports and lean closely spaced ribs at about 45 degrees
Layer branches, leaves and debris from bottom upward like roof shingles until the shelter is rain-shedding and compact
es: Elige lugar seguro y aísla el suelo primero
Fija la viga y coloca costillas estables
Cubre de abajo hacia arriba como tejas
en: Choose a safe site and insulate the ground first
Secure the ridgepole and stable ribs
Cover bottom-up like roof shingles
refugio_naturaleza.avoid: ridgepole or standing frame in first panel, dead branch overhead, giant open shelter, sparse roofing, fire inside, impossible unsupported ridgepole

senas_rescate.title: Visible and audible rescue signaling
senas_rescate.context: same single adult survivor in orange jacket at one open clearing with whistle, signal mirror and large orange ground panel
panels: single survivor lays one very large high-contrast orange ground signal in clearing
same survivor blows one clearly visible whistle and raises one hand to listen between groups of blasts
same survivor alone holds signal mirror near face, extends other hand with two fingers as sight toward one distant helicopter and aims reflected spot through them
es: Haz una señal grande en un área visible
Emite tres silbidos, pausa y repite
Dirige el reflejo del espejo hacia el rescate
en: Make a large signal in a visible area
Give three whistle blasts, pause and repeat
Aim a mirror flash toward rescuers
senas_rescate.avoid: duplicated survivor, two people, fire, missing mirror, random waving, cliff edge, impossible helicopter scale

shock.title: First aid for suspected shock
shock.context: same pale conscious adult casualty and rescuer with gloves, blanket and phone in one safe outdoor training scene
panels: Identify and control a visible simulated bleeding source with firm pressure before changing position
Lay the casualty flat on an insulated surface, keep head and spine aligned, and do not elevate legs when injury is suspected
Cover with a dry blanket, call emergency services, reassure and continuously monitor breathing without giving food or drink
es: Trata primero la causa visible
Acuesta y mantén alineado sin movimientos innecesarios
Abriga, llama y vigila respiración
en: Treat the visible cause first
Lay flat and aligned without unnecessary movement
Keep warm, call and monitor breathing
shock.avoid: automatic leg elevation with trauma, seated casualty, food or drink, direct heat, leaving casualty alone

terremoto.title: Drop, Cover and Hold On
terremoto.context: same adult, same clothing, same sturdy dining table and same interior room during one earthquake
panels: At the first shaking, immediately drop low beside the sturdy table, away from windows and tall unsecured furniture
Move fully under the table and cover head and neck with one arm, keeping the whole body below the tabletop
Hold firmly to a table leg and remain under cover until shaking stops
es: Agáchate al comenzar el movimiento
Cúbrete bajo una mesa resistente
Sujétate y permanece cubierto
en: Drop when shaking starts
Cover under a sturdy table
Hold on and stay covered
terremoto.avoid: running outside, doorway myth, standing, glass near casualty, impossible table, changing room

trauma_cabeza_columna.title: Suspected head and spine injury stabilization training
